meta.goal: Design a battery for power tools: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah, support 5C discharge (capacity retention >= 95%), support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60 C, power density >= 4000 W/kg.
meta.base_params_basis: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (baseline teaching parameterization); materials use system baseline
meta.retention_5c_definition: 5C_discharge (dfn) capacity / 1C_discharge (dfn) capacity, same parameters; mechanically computed
meta.T_max_definition: max cell temperature under 4C_charge_45C protocol (thermal lumped, ambient 318.15 K); 60 C = 333.15 K
meta.plated_definition: anode_potential_v min < 0 V during 4C charge -> plated=true

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (start Chen2020 per anchor default; switch only if ceiling assessment infeasible)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (transport parameter overrides: Electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity, Cation transference number)
freedoms.cell_architecture: adjustable (electrode thickness/porosity/N-P, separator thickness/porosity, current collector thickness, particle radius)
